description: CodeBoarding analyzes source codebases through a multi-stage static analysis, AI reasoning, and documentation pipeline. The process begins as Static Analysis Engine and Language Adapters & Tooling inspect the target repository, provision language server binaries, and extract control-flow and symbol-call graphs across detected programming languages. Agent Tools & Plugin Registry exposes these structural and CFG insights as query tools and extensible health check plugins. Guided by these tools, Architecture Agents perform iterative LLM reasoning and validation to cluster code symbols, identify architectural boundaries, and resolve inter-component relationships. Finally, Analysis Workflow Orchestration orchestrates full, incremental, or partial analysis runs, generating interactive architectural diagrams, health check summaries, and multi-format documentation artifacts (HTML, Markdown, MDX, RST).
